title: Spokes and Saguaros Offers Tucson Area Guiding and Skills Courses
content:
This year, Katie Emory decided it was time to launch her own guiding and skills company in Tucson, Arizona. Spokes and Sagauros offers local tours, skills lessons, and custom tours to make your trip to the Sonoran Desert easy and fun.

Katie’s fear of company ownership seemed less scary than not reaching her full potential. Being from Tucson, racing, guiding, and enjoying bikes for the past 13 years was the easy part. Making financial decisions with a small nest egg accumulated from guiding, designing a website, and being humble enough to look for community help was the hard part.

Her approach with Spokes and Saguaros is to minimize risk and maximize fun. She wants clients to feel taken care of in the land of hard and harsh elements. The beauty that lies within the trails is the beauty that draws her to share it with others. All abilities are welcome (don’t listen to that Gila monster). She can cherry-pick the best trails for the experience you’re looking to achieve. Let Katie show you the parts that most visitors don’t know exist on the other side of I10.

Spokes and Saguaros has started up entry-level skill groups for women new to Tucson who want to get into mountain biking but don’t feel like signing “rock on” each time they hit a drop. The first one is Sept 19th in Tucson, and Katie would love for you to join. Reach out if you are interested!

If you’re looking for a unique or specific experience, Spokes and Saguaros can cater to that too. Got the fam with you? Your parents want to tag along? Is it a bachelor/ bachelorette trip? Katie’s got you!
